title: Pre-Logon VPN for Cloud & Hybrid-Joined Devices — First-Time Off-Network Sign-In & Password Reset
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (design + decision + scenario/validation product sitting ABOVE the two pre-logon deployment products; less new tooling, more architecture/decision + off-network first-logon & password-reset scenario coverage).

Scoped to the DECISION + SCENARIO + VALIDATION gap — it does NOT re-teach the full PLAP/SBL or device-tunnel deployments (those are separate products); it references them by their object-naming conventions and covers when-to-use-which, cached-credential behavior, off-network password reset, DC reachability, and break-glass.
